pattern: The proof is one click in
as_stated_in_deck: 230 of 536 arguments are supported only on another page of the same site. The front door asserts; the case study establishes.
MAVEN_boundary: 'Elsewhere on the same site' is not synonymous with 'case study,' and off-home-page evidence does not always fully establish the proposition.
MAVEN_note: Keep headline. Suggested body: '230 of 536 arguments depend on evidence found elsewhere on the same site. The proposition often appears before the evidence that supports it.'

pattern: Closer to the sale, closer to the seller's own data
as_stated_in_deck: Retail media, marketing clouds and the outcome sellers publish the richest figures and read them from systems they own. Retail media: 0 third-party across 44 outcome claims.
MAVEN_boundary: The directional pattern is interpretive: 'distance from sale' and seller-controlled data were not coded as a market-wide measured relationship.
MAVEN_note: Keep as a labeled pattern from the sector reads, not an empirical law.

pattern: The adjudicators are the least adjudicated
as_stated_in_deck: Measurement and verification carry three third-party figures between them across 95 outcome claims (S06: 1 of 49; S07: 2 of 46).
MAVEN_boundary: The 3/95 count holds. 'Least' is not literally established because other sectors, including Retail Media, have zero third-party outcome claims.
MAVEN_note: Suggested headline: 'The adjudicators are lightly adjudicated.'

as_stated_in_deck: In creative and workflow, hours and assets are counted where media results would be. 53 of 66 creative outcome claims carry a figure; almost none of the figures is a media result.
MAVEN_boundary: Creative strongly supports production outcomes; Workflow is primarily pipeline/process time, not production.
MAVEN_note: Either limit to Creative or broaden to 'Operational outcomes stand in for market outcomes.'

as_stated_in_deck: Across 2,213 claims and 627 pages no seller states a remedy tied to a result. Eight guarantee-coded claims exist and all cover something upstream of the sale.
MAVEN_boundary: No captured page states a remedy tied to a result. The record cannot establish that no seller's actual fee moves because private contracts and many pricing surfaces are unseen.
